blockers.allianz-agcs: Allianz Commercial / AGCS SFCR 2024 reports ~€18bn integrated gross premium globally; segment tables split by region and SII LoB only — no named Energy/power/renewables premium line with absolute GWP.
blockers.convex: Convex Group Ltd consolidated AR/FCR 2024: $5,166m total GWP with territory-of-coverage split only. AM Best credit report cites energy at 7% of GWP — percentage-only, no absolute energy premium in primary filing.
blockers.munich-re: Munich Re Group SFCR 2024 and AR 2024: insurance revenue by Reinsurance (P-C, L&H) and ERGO segments; no named energy/power/onshore-renewables GWP line.
blockers.rsa-intact: RSA Insurance Group SFCR 2024: material SUK lines are Fire/property, motor, Marine aviation and transport, GL — no named energy premium. 2023 AR discloses % renewable share of energy portfolio only, not absolute GWP.
blockers.zurich: Zurich Group FCR 2024 / annual results: $46.6bn P&C gross written premiums by region and broad line categories; energy cited as a specialty line in narrative but no separately disclosed energy/power premium.
blockers.bhsi-uk: BHIIL (UK writing entity for BHSI) SFCR: gross premiums by Solvency II LoB without a named Energy/power segment. BHSI Power/MB product materials describe appetite only — no premium disclosure.
blockers.hdi-global-uk: HDI Global SE SFCR 2024: largest divisions are Fire and other damage to property (48%) and General liability (32%); energy/power underwriting referenced strategically but not as a named premium segment.
blockers.sompo-intl-energy-uk: Endurance Worldwide Insurance Ltd (EWIL) SFCR 2023 (latest public): gross premiums by SII LoB (Fire/property, GL, Marine aviation and transport, etc.); Energy named in narrative growth commentary only. No 2024 EWIL SFCR with energy GWP split published.
blockers.qbe-europe: QBE Europe Syndicate 2999 accounts FY2024: 'Marine and Energy' trading unit described as ~11% of GWP in narrative but no absolute unit GWP disclosed. SII class table 'Marine, aviation and transport' (£281.8m) over-includes marine — not a narrow energy line.
